rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst, including expanded cavity, thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. Some details such as central ICM location and absence of vacuolization/lysis are not reliably verifiable from a single image and slightly overstate certainty.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, endometrial thickness, male factor context, first-cycle status, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo grade and favorable patient factors. Minor overreach includes linking morphology to a strong likelihood of euploidy and a relatively optimistic implantation range.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including single good-quality day-5 transfer context and luteal support. Slight deviations include overconfident euploidy inference from morphology and somewhat aggressive implantation estimate.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, counseling, lifestyle optimization, and cryopreservation planning. Useful but somewhat generic and incomplete in future male-factor workup due to truncation.
